description: Taḥwīl-aware isnad gold-set annotation instruction kit + SOP. Documentation (annotation guide) + tooling (next-candidate pull, validator, calibration test, IAA tooling) that makes manual annotation of tahweel-gold.jsonl repeatable, teachable, and quality-checked. Enables gold-set growth from 5 → 30 → 100+ fixtures by future annotators (Islamic studies students, fellow scholars, optionally LLM-assisted draft annotation under human verification).
